meaning.en: To enrage or anger, referring to making the face purple or red with blood.

meaning.en: Of writing, to make overly flowery or showy; to embellish unduly.
meaning.vi: Bằng văn bản, để làm cho quá hoa hoặc sặc sỡ; để tôn tạo quá mức.
